_doc: AoP's OWN texture sets by revision (scripts/havok/texture_sets.py). Each mod keeps its own registry: a model's registry is found by texture_sets.registry_for (the first <mod>/tools/texture_sets.json or <mod>/config/texture_sets.json above it). Register a set here when AoP produces revisioned own textures that must not be mixed (see the aoe-uv-atlas-export skill, texture-set coherence).
The Korean sets moved to ../age-of-pirates-koreans/tools/texture_sets.json on 2026-10-09 with the Korean models.
